senses.en: opposite to something or inconsistent with it
the opposite of what has been said or suggested

ex.en: Contrary to the forecast, sunshine filled our garden.
ex.zh: 与天气预报相反，阳光洒满了我们的花园。

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, expanding road networks does not always reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
ex.zh: 与普遍看法相反，扩大道路网络并不总能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。

col: to the contrary｜表明相反情况的
tip: on the contrary用于纠正前述观点，意为恰恰相反。

senses.en: following methods or ideas that are usual and widely accepted

ex.en: We chose a conventional oven instead of a microwave.
ex.zh: 我们选了普通烤箱，而不是微波炉。

ex.en: Conventional farming methods often rely on chemical fertilisers to maintain high crop yields over large areas.
ex.zh: 常规农业方法往往依赖化肥来维持大面积农田的高产。

tip: conventional强调符合常规，不一定指历史悠久。

senses.en: to make someone believe something is true
to persuade someone to do something

ex.en: The photos convinced me that the flat was spacious.
ex.zh: 这些照片让我相信那套公寓很宽敞。

ex.en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

senses.en: to work together to achieve a shared aim
to help by doing what someone asks

ex.en: We cooperated with our neighbours to clean the shared garden.
ex.zh: 我们和邻居一起清理了共用花园。

ex.en: Countries must cooperate on climate policy because pollution crosses borders and affects communities far from its source.
ex.zh: 各国必须在气候政策上合作，因为污染会跨越国界，影响远离污染源的社区。

col: cooperate on a project｜在项目上合作
tip: 不及物：与人合作用with，就某事合作用on。

senses.en: a long passage connecting rooms inside a building
a strip of land connecting areas for movement or transport

ex.en: Her footsteps echoed along the empty corridor after class.
ex.zh: 下课后，她的脚步声在空荡荡的走廊里回响。

ex.en: Wildlife corridors allow animals to move safely between habitats that roads and urban development have separated.
ex.zh: 野生动物廊道使动物能够在被道路和城市开发分隔的栖息地之间安全迁移。

col: a wildlife corridor｜野生动物廊道
tip: 既指建筑内走廊，也指连接地区的狭长地带。

senses.en: A small house, usually in the countryside.

ex.en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
ex.zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。

ex.en: Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.
ex.zh: 将闲置的村舍改为度假住宿，可以为农村家庭增加一项收入来源。

tip: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: illegal activities considered as a whole
an action that breaks the law

ex.en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
ex.zh: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。

ex.en: Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.
ex.zh: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。

tip: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。

senses.en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action

ex.en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
ex.zh: 水管破裂让家里陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人推迟搬进自己的住所。

col: in times of crisis｜在危机时期
tip: 复数为crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意词尾发音。

senses.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something
expressing disapproval or carefully judging strengths and weaknesses
so serious that someone may die or something may fail

ex.en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
ex.zh: 我创业时，你的支持至关重要。

ex.en: Access to clean water is critical to improving public health in rapidly growing urban communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁用水对改善快速发展城市社区的公共卫生至关重要。

col: critical to success｜对成功至关重要
tip: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

senses.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

ex.en: Your spare key was crucial when I locked myself out.
ex.zh: 我把自己锁在门外时，你的备用钥匙派上了关键用场。

ex.en: Access to reliable public transport is crucial for people seeking employment beyond their immediate neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 对于想在居住地附近以外寻找工作的人来说，可靠的公共交通至关重要。

col: crucial to success｜对成功至关重要
tip: 比important语气强；常用be crucial to。

senses.en: A style of cooking associated with a place or culture.

ex.en: This little restaurant serves delicious cuisine from southern India.
ex.zh: 这家小餐馆供应美味的印度南部菜肴。

ex.en: Traditional cuisine can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their cultural identity.
ex.zh: 传统菜系既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留文化特色。

tip: cuisine指菜系或烹饪风格，不指一道菜。

senses.en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space
a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage

ex.en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
ex.zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边，看着外面的雨。

ex.en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
ex.zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。

col: draw the curtains｜拉上或拉开窗帘
tip: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。

senses.en: a series of events or stages that repeats
to travel by bicycle
a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling

ex.en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
ex.zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。

ex.en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。

col: cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

senses.zh: 奶制的；乳品（业）的；乳制品；乳品店；牛奶厂

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: n.滴滴涕(旧时农业杀虫剂)

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.
A person or people who have died.

ex.en: She keeps a photograph of her deceased grandfather nearby.
ex.zh: 她在身边放着一张已故祖父的照片。

ex.en: Museums sometimes display personal belongings of deceased artists to help visitors understand their lives and creative influences.
ex.zh: 博物馆有时会展出已故艺术家的私人物品，帮助参观者了解其生平和创作所受的影响。

tip: 正式用语；the deceased可指一位或多位死者。

senses.en: To become smaller or make something smaller in amount.
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Our electricity bills decreased after we replaced the old heater.
ex.zh: 我们换掉旧取暖器后，电费减少了。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
ex.zh: 鸭妈妈张开翅膀保护小鸭。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.
A period of waiting before something happens or continues.

ex.en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
ex.zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。

ex.en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。

tip: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

senses.en: To show clearly that something is true or exists.
To show someone how something works or is done.
To gather publicly to express support or opposition.

ex.en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
ex.zh: 这些泥脚印表明有人进过厨房。

ex.en: Recent studies demonstrate that regular physical activity can improve concentration and support students' mental health.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，经常进行体育活动可以提高注意力，并促进学生的心理健康。

col: demonstrate a commitment to｜体现对……的投入
tip: 证明某事常用demonstrate that从句。

senses.en: Say that something is not true or did not happen.
Refuse to give or allow someone something.

ex.en: She denied eating the last piece of cake.
ex.zh: 她否认吃了最后一块蛋糕。

ex.en: No child should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 任何孩子都不应因为家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。

col: deny doing something｜否认做过某事
deny access to｜不准使用或进入
tip: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。

senses.en: The act of leaving a place.
A change from what is usual or expected.

ex.en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
ex.zh: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。

ex.en: The new housing policy represents a significant departure from previous approaches to urban development.
ex.zh: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。

col: a departure from tradition｜对传统的突破
tip: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。

senses.en: To make someone feel unhappy and without hope.
To reduce an amount, value, or level of activity.
To push something down.

ex.en: Days of grey skies and constant rain depress me.
ex.zh: 连日灰暗的天空和不停的雨让我感到沮丧。

ex.en: High borrowing costs can depress consumer spending, making it harder for small businesses to survive.
ex.zh: 高昂的借贷成本会抑制消费支出，使小企业更难生存。

tip: depressed形容人感到沮丧，depressing形容事物令人沮丧。

senses.en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness
having little economic activity or few opportunities

ex.en: He felt depressed after weeks of unsuccessful job hunting.
ex.zh: 连续数周求职无果后，他感到很沮丧。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让经济萧条地区的居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

col: economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

senses.en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything.
Wanting or needing something very badly.
Extremely serious or dangerous and needing immediate action.

ex.en: Desperate to find her cat, Aisha searched every nearby garden.
ex.zh: 艾莎急切地想找到她的猫，搜遍了附近每个花园。

ex.en: After prolonged drought, farming communities face desperate conditions and require urgent support to restore their livelihoods.
ex.zh: 长期干旱后，农业社区面临危急处境，急需援助以恢复生计。

col: a desperate attempt｜孤注一掷的尝试
desperate measures｜不得已的极端措施
tip: 渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。

senses.en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
ex.zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。

ex.en: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供新鲜水果作为餐后甜点，有助于培养儿童更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: an object or machine designed for a particular purpose
a method used to achieve an effect or particular result

ex.en: This tiny device tracks my steps throughout the day.
ex.zh: 这个小装置会记录我一整天的步数。

ex.en: A portable medical device can help patients monitor their health without frequent hospital visits.
ex.zh: 便携式医疗设备能帮助患者监测健康状况，无须频繁去医院。

tip: device是名词；devise是动词，意为设计或想出。

senses.en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.

ex.en: I devote an hour each evening to practising the piano.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上花一个小时练钢琴。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways.
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克价格不同，但都很好看。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used.
Think about information until you understand it.
A short collection of the main points from longer material.

ex.en: My stomach finds heavy meals difficult to digest.
ex.zh: 我的胃很难消化油腻丰盛的饭菜。

ex.en: Students need sufficient time to digest complex information before applying it to unfamiliar problems.
ex.zh: 学生需要充足的时间理解复杂信息，然后才能将其用于解决陌生的问题。

tip: 名词重音在首音节，读 /ˈdaɪdʒest/。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Put something where people can see it
An arrangement of things for people to look at
A screen that shows information or images

ex.en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
ex.zh: 面包店把新鲜蛋糕陈列在前窗旁。

ex.en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
ex.zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。

col: a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列
tip: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

senses.zh: 遥远的；远处的；疏远的；心不在焉的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: clearly different or separate from something else
easy to notice, hear, see, or recognize

ex.en: The twins have similar faces but distinct personalities.
ex.zh: 这对双胞胎长相相似，性格却不同。

ex.en: Public transport and private cars serve distinct needs, so urban planners should consider both.
ex.zh: 公共交通和私家车满足不同的需求，因此城市规划者应兼顾两者。

col: two distinct groups｜两个不同的群体
tip: distinct from表示“与……不同”；勿混淆为distant。

senses.en: to recognize the difference between people or things
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: I can distinguish the twins by their voices.
ex.zh: 我能通过声音分辨这对双胞胎。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing

ex.en: The music distracted me while I was doing homework.
ex.zh: 我做作业时，音乐让我分心了。

ex.en: Frequent phone notifications can distract employees from complex tasks and reduce their ability to concentrate for long periods.
ex.zh: 频繁的手机通知会使员工在处理复杂任务时分心，并削弱他们长时间集中注意力的能力。

col: distract someone from｜使某人从……分心
distract attention from｜转移对……的注意力
tip: 常用distract sb from sth或doing sth。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: relating to activities within a particular country
relating to the home, family, or household tasks
kept by people rather than living in the wild

ex.en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
ex.zh: 我们乘坐国内航班去了北部海岸。

ex.en: Investment in domestic food production can reduce a country's dependence on imports and strengthen its economy.
ex.zh: 投资国内粮食生产可以减少一国对进口的依赖，并增强其经济实力。

tip: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

senses.en: A thick mixture of flour and liquid used for baking.
Money, in informal speech.

ex.en: Mina kneaded the dough on a flour-covered kitchen table.
ex.zh: 米娜在撒了面粉的厨房桌子上揉面。

ex.en: Allowing dough to rise slowly can improve bread quality without the need for artificial additives.
ex.zh: 让面团缓慢发酵，无须使用人工添加剂也能改善面包品质。

col: let the dough rise｜让面团发酵膨胀
tip: 不可数名词；稀的面糊通常叫batter。

senses.en: an early version of writing that may be changed
to write an early version of a document

ex.en: I saved the first draft of my letter.
ex.zh: 我保存了这封信的初稿。

ex.en: Governments should publish draft legislation early so that citizens can comment before final decisions are made.
ex.zh: 政府应尽早公布立法草案，让公民在最终决定作出前发表意见。

tip: 表“草稿”英美均用draft；穿堂风英式用draught。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a tool or machine used to make holes
repeated practice of a skill or emergency procedure
to make holes with a tool or train through repetition

ex.en: I borrowed a drill to put up the shelf.
ex.zh: 我借了一把电钻来安装架子。

ex.en: Regular fire drills help students respond calmly during emergencies and identify the safest routes out of school buildings.
ex.zh: 定期消防演习帮助学生在紧急情况下冷静应对，并辨认出离开校舍的最安全路线。

tip: fire drill 是消防演习，不是灭火用的钻具。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The time when daylight fades before night.

ex.en: We reached the campsite at dusk and lit a lantern.
ex.zh: 我们在黄昏时到达营地，点亮了一盏灯。

ex.en: Improved street lighting can make public spaces safer for pedestrians who travel home after dusk.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明能让天黑后步行回家的人更安全地使用公共空间。

col: from dawn to dusk｜从黎明到黄昏
tip: 在黄昏用at dusk；dawn表示黎明。

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

ex.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
ex.zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。

ex.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
ex.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

col: have an edge over｜比……有优势
tip: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

senses.en: A particular version of a book or other published work.

senses.zh: 报刊的一期；节目的一期
senses.en: One particular issue of a newspaper or broadcast programme.

ex.en: I bought the latest edition of this gardening guide.
ex.zh: 我买了这本园艺指南的最新版。

ex.en: The revised edition of the textbook includes recent research on renewable energy and sustainable urban development.
ex.zh: 这本教材的修订版收录了关于可再生能源和城市可持续发展的最新研究。

tip: edition指版本或期次；一本实体书通常叫a copy。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 教师；教育工作者；教育家

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。

col: efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源
tip: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

senses.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
ex.zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

ex.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
ex.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

tip: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

senses.en: attractive and graceful in appearance or style
simple and effective in solving a problem

ex.en: She wore an elegant blue dress to dinner.
ex.zh: 她穿着一条优雅的蓝色连衣裙去赴晚宴。

ex.en: The architect proposed an elegant solution that improved ventilation without increasing the building's energy consumption.
ex.zh: 建筑师提出了一个简洁巧妙的方案，在不增加建筑能耗的情况下改善通风。

col: elegant solution｜简洁巧妙的解决方案
tip: 既可形容外观优雅，也可形容方案简洁巧妙。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly
an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something

ex.en: We encountered a curious fox on our evening walk.
ex.zh: 我们傍晚散步时遇到了一只好奇的狐狸。

ex.en: Students studying abroad may encounter cultural differences that challenge their assumptions about communication and social behaviour.
ex.zh: 留学生可能遇到文化差异，从而反思自己对沟通和社会行为的原有看法。

tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an encounter with。

senses.en: To attract someone's attention and keep them interested or involved.
To take part in an activity.
To hire someone to perform a particular job.

ex.en: The puppet show engaged even the youngest children.
ex.zh: 这场木偶戏连最小的孩子都吸引住了。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to engage in community activities that develop cooperation and a sense of responsibility.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生参与社区活动，培养合作能力和责任感。

col: engage with an audience｜与观众互动
engage someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip: 参与活动用engage in；与人互动用engage with。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: Officially join, or register someone for, a course or organisation.

ex.en: I plan to enrol on a cooking course next month.
ex.zh: 我打算下个月报名参加烹饪课程。

ex.en: Governments can encourage adults to enrol in vocational training by offering flexible schedules and financial support.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供灵活的课程安排和经济支持，鼓励成年人报名参加职业培训。

col: enrol on a course｜报名课程
enrol in a programme｜报名项目
tip: 英式 enrol，美式 enroll；过去式均为 enrolled。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
ex.zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。

ex.en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

col: a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: Completely, with nothing left out.

ex.en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
ex.zh: 我把炉子上煮着的汤忘得一干二净。

ex.en: A transport system powered entirely by renewable energy could significantly reduce a city's carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 完全由可再生能源驱动的交通系统可以显著减少城市的碳排放。

tip: not entirely表示不完全，并非完全不。

senses.en: to imagine a future situation or possibility

ex.en: I envision a small garden behind our new house.
ex.zh: 我想象着新家后面有一座小花园。

ex.en: Urban planners envision a future in which most residents can reach essential services on foot.
ex.zh: 城市规划者展望这样的未来：大多数居民步行即可享用基本服务。

col: envision a world｜设想一个世界
tip: 后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation
Relating to the most important characteristics of something
A necessary item or basic fact, usually mentioned in plural

ex.en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
ex.zh: 这次冬日散步必须穿一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共卫生至关重要。

col: essential for survival｜生存所必需的
tip: 名词常用复数 essentials，表示必需品或基本要点。

senses.en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.
An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.

ex.en: We estimate the repairs will take about three days.
ex.zh: 我们估计维修大约需要三天。

ex.en: Researchers estimate that improved public transport could significantly reduce the number of cars entering city centres.
ex.zh: 研究人员估计，改善公共交通可显著减少进入市中心的汽车数量。

tip: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

senses.en: Carefully judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something

ex.en: We evaluated three cameras before choosing one for our trip.
ex.zh: 我们评估了三款相机，才选定一款用于旅行。

ex.en: Governments should evaluate the long-term environmental effects of major construction projects before approving them.
ex.zh: 政府应在批准大型建设项目之前评估其长期环境影响。

tip: 强调依据标准作判断；不只是描述事物。

senses.en: far better than usual
unusual and outside normal circumstances

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
ex.zh: 能力出众的学生可能需要更有挑战性的任务，才能持续投入课堂学习。

tip: 常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

senses.en: to become larger or make something larger
to add more details to an explanation or discussion

ex.en: The dough expanded as it rested in the warm kitchen.
ex.zh: 面团在温暖的厨房里静置时膨胀起来了。

ex.en: Universities should expand access to online courses while ensuring that disadvantaged students have adequate equipment and internet connections.
ex.zh: 大学应扩大在线课程的覆盖范围，同时确保弱势学生拥有足够的设备和网络条件。

col: expand access to｜扩大获得……的机会
expand on an idea｜进一步阐述想法
tip: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。

senses.en: A belief that something will happen.
A standard of success or behaviour someone hopes for.

ex.en: We packed warm coats in expectation of cold weather.
ex.zh: 我们预计天气会冷，就带上了厚外套。

ex.en: High parental expectations can motivate students, but excessive pressure may negatively affect their mental health.
ex.zh: 父母的高期望可以激励学生，但过大的压力可能损害他们的心理健康。

col: in expectation of｜预料到；期待着
tip: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。

senses.en: money spent or needed for a particular purpose
harm or disadvantage caused while benefiting someone or something else

ex.en: Rent is our biggest expense every single month.
ex.zh: 房租是我们每个月最大的一笔开支。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport without placing the entire expense on residents who already face financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，而不应让已经面临经济困难的居民承担全部费用。

col: at the expense of｜以…为代价
tip: 日常各项开支常用复数expenses；expensive是形容词。

senses.en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence
To reveal something hidden, especially wrongdoing
To uncover something previously hidden or protected

ex.en: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight without protection.
ex.zh: 不要在没有防护的情况下让皮肤暴露在强烈阳光下。

ex.en: Investigative journalism can expose unsafe working conditions and pressure companies to improve their treatment of employees.
ex.zh: 调查报道能够揭露不安全的工作条件，并向企业施压，促使其改善员工待遇。

col: expose someone to risk｜使某人面临风险
expose children to music｜让儿童接触音乐
tip: expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 扩建部分；扩大；电话分机

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to remove or obtain something from a larger source
a short passage taken from a longer piece of writing
a substance obtained by removing it from its original source

ex.en: The dentist carefully extracted the damaged tooth this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，牙医小心地拔掉了那颗坏牙。

ex.en: Researchers extract useful information from large datasets to identify patterns in household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 研究人员从大型数据集中提取有用信息，以识别家庭能源消耗的规律。

col: an extract from a novel｜小说节选
tip: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈekstrækt/。

senses.en: Much better or more impressive than usual.
Very unusual or surprising.

ex.en: My grandmother has an extraordinary memory for people's birthdays.
ex.zh: 我奶奶记别人生日的本领特别出众。

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology demonstrate the extraordinary potential of cooperation between scientists and engineers.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的最新进展展现了科学家与工程师合作的非凡潜力。

tip: 比very good更强调超出寻常，也可指奇特。

senses.en: material made by weaving or knitting fibres
the connected parts that form a society or organisation

ex.en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
ex.zh: 这种柔软的布料做夏季连衣裙会很舒服。

ex.en: Community centres strengthen the social fabric by bringing together residents from different cultural and economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区中心让不同文化与经济背景的居民聚在一起，从而巩固社会纽带。

tip: 泛指布料常不可数；不同种类可用fabrics。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Something helpful you do for someone.
Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something.
To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
ex.zh: 你能帮我一个忙，给我的植物浇浇水吗？

ex.en: Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这有助于缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。

col: do someone a favour｜帮某人一个忙
favour one option over another｜更倾向于某个选项
tip: 英式拼写为favour，美式为favor；帮忙用do。

senses.en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone
A man or boy, referred to informally
A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions

ex.en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
ex.zh: 我和一位同行的乘客共撑了一把伞。

ex.en: Students who regularly exchange ideas with fellow learners often develop greater confidence and stronger communication skills.
ex.zh: 经常与同学交流想法的学生往往能增强自信，提高沟通能力。

tip: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

senses.en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow

ex.en: We added fertilizer to help the tomato plants grow.
ex.zh: 我们施了肥，帮助番茄植株生长。

ex.en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizer can pollute nearby rivers and damage the ecosystems that depend on them.
ex.zh: 过量使用化肥会污染附近河流，破坏依赖这些河流的生态系统。

tip: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Information discovered through research or an investigation.
An official decision made by a court after considering evidence.

ex.en: The doctor's findings explained why I felt so tired.
ex.zh: 医生的检查结果解释了我为什么这么疲倦。

ex.en: The findings indicate that affordable public transport can significantly improve access to employment in disadvantaged areas.
ex.zh: 研究结果表明，价格实惠的公共交通能显著改善弱势地区居民的就业机会。

col: publish the findings｜公布调查结果
a finding of fact｜事实认定
tip: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。

senses.en: a business that provides goods or professional services
solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape
unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken

ex.en: My sister works for a small engineering firm.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家小型工程公司工作。

ex.en: Each firm should provide regular training to help employees adapt to technological change.
ex.zh: 每家公司都应提供定期培训，帮助员工适应技术变革。

col: take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the particular taste of food or drink
to give food or drink a particular taste
a distinctive quality that gives something its character

ex.en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 新鲜罗勒让这道汤有了宜人的风味。

ex.en: School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.
ex.zh: 学校的烹饪课可以教孩子如何在不过量加盐或糖的情况下提升食物风味。

tip: 英式拼写flavour，美式拼写flavor。

senses.en: To leave quickly to escape danger or an unpleasant situation.

ex.en: The birds fled when the dog entered the garden.
ex.zh: 狗一进花园，鸟儿就飞走了。

ex.en: Severe flooding can force rural families to flee their homes and seek shelter in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 严重洪灾可能迫使农村家庭逃离家园，到附近城镇寻求庇护。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fled；可直接接逃离的地点。

senses.en: To move continuously, like water through a channel.
Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.

ex.en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
ex.zh: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。

ex.en: Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。

senses.en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
ex.zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。

ex.en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
ex.zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。

col: a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨
tip: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

ex.en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
ex.zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols
a particular method or mixture used to achieve something
specially prepared milk used to feed babies

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a formula for calculating area.
ex.zh: 老师给我们讲解了一个计算面积的公式。

ex.en: There is no single formula for reducing urban poverty, since local economic conditions vary considerably.
ex.zh: 减少城市贫困没有统一的方法，因为各地经济状况差异很大。

tip: 复数可用formulas或formulae；方法常接for。

senses.en: a structure that sends water into the air
a device supplying a stream of water for drinking

ex.en: Children watched the fountain sparkle in the afternoon sunlight.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着喷泉在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。

ex.en: A fountain can make a public square more attractive, although its maintenance requires water and energy.
ex.zh: 喷泉可以让公共广场更具吸引力，但维护喷泉需要消耗水和能源。

tip: drinking fountain是公共饮水器；fountain pen是钢笔。

senses.en: A basic structure of ideas or rules supporting something
A supporting structure that gives something its shape

ex.en: Our coach gave us a framework for planning each workout.
ex.zh: 教练给了我们一个规划每次训练的基本框架。

ex.en: Governments need a clear legal framework to protect personal information collected by online services.
ex.zh: 政府需要明确的法律框架，以保护网络服务收集的个人信息。

col: within the framework of｜在……框架内
tip: 常用a framework for sth，表示某事的基本框架。

senses.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.
To stop something changing or being used temporarily.
To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
ex.zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。

ex.en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。

tip: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

senses.en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them.
To cover or become covered with a thin layer of ice.
To cover a cake with a sweet, creamy topping.

ex.en: A thin frost covered the grass outside our kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房外的草地上覆盖着一层薄霜。

ex.en: Unexpected spring frost can damage young crops, reducing yields and increasing financial pressure on farmers.
ex.zh: 突如其来的春季霜冻会损伤幼苗，降低产量并增加农民的经济压力。

col: frost a cake｜给蛋糕涂糖霜
tip: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Forming the essential basis of something.
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Trust is fundamental to a happy life together.
ex.zh: 信任是共同幸福生活的根本。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said

ex.en: The flat is spacious; furthermore, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。

ex.en: Public transport reduces traffic congestion; furthermore, it can make cities more accessible to residents without cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，此外还能让没有汽车的居民更方便地在城市中出行。

col: furthermore, it is important｜此外，重要的是
furthermore, evidence suggests｜此外，证据表明
tip: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.

ex.en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
ex.zh: 先把大蒜压碎，再放进汤里。

ex.en: Using garlic and herbs can add flavour to meals without increasing their salt content.
ex.zh: 使用大蒜和香草可以给饭菜增添风味，而不增加盐含量。

col: a clove of garlic｜一瓣大蒜
tip: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。

senses.en: Cause something to exist or happen.
Produce electricity, heat, or another form of energy.

ex.en: Our weekend bake sale generated enough money for new books.
ex.zh: 我们周末的糕点义卖筹到了足够买新书的钱。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can generate employment while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 及物动词，可接电力、收入、兴趣、想法等宾语。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 有天赋的；有天才的；天资聪慧的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.

ex.en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
ex.zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。

ex.en: Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.
ex.zh: 饲养山羊可以为农村家庭提供稳定的奶源和额外收入。

col: a herd of goats｜一群山羊
tip: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

senses.en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly
to get food, drink, or something else quickly
to attract someone's attention strongly

ex.en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
ex.zh: 她抓起雨伞，朝公交车跑去。

ex.en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传常用醒目的图片吸引注意，鼓励人们改变不健康的习惯。

col: grab someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
grab a bite｜匆忙吃点东西
tip: grab较口语化；过去式grabbed，分词grabbing。

senses.en: To understand something, especially a difficult idea.
To take and hold something firmly.
An understanding of something, or a firm hold.

ex.en: I finally grasped the rules after watching one round.
ex.zh: 看完一轮后，我终于弄懂了规则。

ex.en: Students grasp complex scientific concepts more easily when teachers connect them to familiar everyday experiences.
ex.zh: 教师将复杂的科学概念与熟悉的日常经历联系起来时，学生更容易理解。

col: a firm grasp of｜对……的扎实理解
within reach or grasp｜力所能及
tip: 表示理解时可作动词；名词常用a grasp of。

senses.en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural.
A shop selling food and basic household supplies.

ex.en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我把两袋食品杂货提进了厨房。

ex.en: Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。

tip: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 哈利法克斯(加拿大城市)

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Meat from a pig's leg, preserved by salting or smoking.

ex.en: I put some ham and cheese in my sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在三明治里放了些火腿和奶酪。

ex.en: Processed meats such as ham often contain substantial amounts of salt, which consumers should consider when planning meals.
ex.zh: 火腿等加工肉类通常含盐量较高，消费者安排膳食时应考虑这一点。

col: a slice of ham｜一片火腿
tip: 表示火腿肉通常不可数；一片用a slice of ham。

senses.en: To deal with a situation, task, or person.
To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands.
The part of an object used for holding or moving it.

ex.en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
ex.zh: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？

ex.en: Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.
ex.zh: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。

tip: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

senses.en: A sheltered area of water where boats can stay safely.
To keep a thought or feeling, often secretly.
To hide or shelter someone, especially someone wanted by authorities.

ex.en: Small fishing boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
ex.zh: 小渔船在日落前回到了港湾。

ex.en: Expanding the harbour could increase trade, but construction may damage nearby coastal habitats.
ex.zh: 扩建港口可能促进贸易，但施工可能破坏附近的沿海栖息地。

tip: 英式拼写harbour，美式拼写harbor。

senses.en: For this reason; as a result
After a stated period measured from now

ex.en: The oven broke, hence our cold dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 烤箱坏了，所以今晚我们吃冷餐。

ex.en: Urban populations are growing rapidly; hence, governments need to invest more in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 城市人口正在迅速增长，因此政府需要加大对可靠公共交通的投入。

col: hence the need for｜因此需要
hence the importance of｜由此可见……的重要性
tip: 正式用语；表示“因此”时，后面也可直接接名词短语。

senses.en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.

senses.zh: 最精彩或最重要的部分
senses.en: The best or most memorable part of an experience.
Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.

ex.en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
ex.zh: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。

ex.en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究强调，方便到达的绿地对城市居民的身心健康十分重要。

col: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题
highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性
the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: all the people who live together in one home
relating to a home and its everyday needs

ex.en: Everyone in our household takes turns washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们家每个人都轮流洗碗。

ex.en: Rising energy prices place considerable pressure on household budgets, particularly among families with lower incomes.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨给家庭预算带来了很大压力，低收入家庭尤其如此。

tip: household强调同住一户，不一定有亲属关系。

senses.zh: 杂交植（动）物；合成物；混合动力车

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: exactly the same in every relevant detail

ex.en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
ex.zh: 我们在不知道对方选择的情况下，买了完全一样的夹克。

ex.en: Providing identical resources to every school may not address differences in students' needs or local circumstances.
ex.zh: 向每所学校提供完全相同的资源，未必能解决学生需求或当地情况的差异。

tip: 常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更强。

senses.zh: 习语；成语；主管；掌管；总的来说；总之

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To suggest something without stating it directly.
To involve something as a necessary result or condition.

ex.en: Are you trying to imply that my cooking is bad?
ex.zh: 你是想暗示我做饭不好吃吗？

ex.en: Higher spending on education does not necessarily imply better outcomes unless resources are allocated effectively.
ex.zh: 教育支出增加不一定意味着成效改善，除非资源得到有效分配。

col: not necessarily imply｜不一定意味着
tip: imply是说话者暗示；infer是听者推断。

senses.en: An event, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.

ex.en: Nobody was hurt in the incident outside the station.
ex.zh: 车站外的那起事件中没有人受伤。

ex.en: Every workplace incident should be investigated carefully so that employers can identify risks and prevent similar problems.
ex.zh: 每起工作场所事件都应得到仔细调查，以便雇主识别风险并防止类似问题发生。

tip: incident指具体事件；incidence指发生率。

senses.en: So surprising that it is difficult to believe
Extremely good, impressive, or great in amount

ex.en: It seems incredible that this tiny seed becomes a tree.
ex.zh: 这粒小小的种子竟能长成大树，真令人难以置信。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology have brought incredible improvements in the quality of life for many patients.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步使许多患者的生活质量得到了惊人的改善。

col: find it incredible｜觉得难以置信
tip: incredible可表难以置信，也可口语赞叹“极好”。

senses.en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection
to spread a feeling or attitude to others

ex.en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
ex.zh: 一只生病的兔子可能传染同笼的其他兔子。

ex.en: Viruses can infect vulnerable patients more easily when hospitals lack effective hygiene measures and adequate ventilation.
ex.zh: 如果医院缺乏有效的卫生措施和充分的通风，病毒就更容易感染身体脆弱的患者。

col: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒
tip: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

senses.en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body

ex.en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 医生检查了我疼痛的喉咙，看是否有感染迹象。

ex.en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 改善卫生条件可以降低感染风险，尤其是在难以获得洁净水的社区。

tip: infection既可指感染过程，也可指一次具体感染。

senses.en: to reach a conclusion using evidence rather than direct statements

ex.en: From her muddy shoes, I inferred she had been gardening.
ex.zh: 从她沾满泥土的鞋子，我推断她刚才在做园艺活。

ex.en: Researchers cannot infer that smaller classes improve learning without examining other factors affecting student performance.
ex.zh: 研究人员如果不考察影响学生表现的其他因素，就不能推断小班教学能改善学习效果。

col: infer from evidence｜根据证据推断
tip: infer是听者推断，imply是说者暗示。

senses.en: A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.

ex.en: Her muddy boots supported my inference about her morning walk.
ex.zh: 她沾满泥的靴子印证了我关于她早晨散过步的推断。

ex.en: Researchers should avoid drawing a firm inference from a small sample without considering alternative explanations.
ex.zh: 研究人员应避免在未考虑其他解释的情况下，根据小样本作出确定的推断。

col: inference from evidence｜基于证据的推断
tip: 常用draw an inference from，指根据证据推断。

senses.en: Happening or existing at the beginning
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
ex.zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the introduction of new ideas, methods, or products
a new idea, method, or product that improves something

ex.en: Our kitchen encourages innovation, so we often try unusual recipes.
ex.zh: 我们家的厨房鼓励创新，所以我们经常尝试新奇的食谱。

ex.en: Public investment in research can encourage innovation and help businesses develop more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 公共科研投入可以鼓励创新，帮助企业开发更可持续的生产方法。

col: a major innovation｜一项重大创新
tip: 表示创新过程时不可数；表示具体新成果时可数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation

ex.en: Helping at the bakery gave me insight into running a business.
ex.zh: 在面包店帮忙让我深入了解了如何经营一家店。

ex.en: Interviews with local residents provide valuable insight into how urban redevelopment affects community relationships and daily routines.
ex.zh: 对当地居民的访谈有助于深入了解城市改造如何影响社区关系和日常生活。

tip: 常用insight into；泛指理解力时通常不可数。

senses.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement
to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。

ex.en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
ex.zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。

col: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事
insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

senses.en: A particular example or occurrence of something.

ex.en: Some fruits freeze well; berries, for instance, keep their flavour.
ex.zh: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。

ex.en: This project provides an instance of successful cooperation between local businesses and environmental research groups.
ex.zh: 这个项目提供了当地企业与环境研究团体成功合作的实例。

col: in this instance｜在这种情况下
tip: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

senses.en: happening immediately, without any delay
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: The warm soup brought instant comfort after our walk.
ex.zh: 散步回来后，热汤立刻让我们感到舒适。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.
An established custom or system within a society.

ex.en: My sister works at a respected institution near home.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在家附近一家备受尊重的机构工作。

ex.en: Every educational institution should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support for students with disabilities.
ex.zh: 每所教育机构都应提供无障碍设施，并为残障学生提供适当支持。

col: the institution of marriage｜婚姻制度
tip: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。

senses.en: To combine separate parts so they work together effectively.
To join, or help someone join, a group or society.

ex.en: This app integrates my calendar with my shopping list.
ex.zh: 这个应用将我的日历和购物清单整合在一起。

ex.en: Schools should integrate digital tools into classroom activities while ensuring that all students have equal access.
ex.zh: 学校应将数字工具融入课堂活动，同时确保所有学生都能平等使用。

tip: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。

senses.zh: 各部分密切协调的；综合的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: very strong or extreme in degree
showing very strong feelings or serious concentration

ex.en: The intense heat made us search for shade.
ex.zh: 酷热让我们四处寻找阴凉处。

ex.en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.
ex.zh: 大学入学名额的激烈竞争，可能给毕业年级学生带来相当大的心理压力。

tip: intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To explain or understand the meaning of something
To translate someone's speech into another language as they speak

ex.en: I interpreted her smile as permission to sit down.
ex.zh: 我把她的微笑理解为允许我坐下。

ex.en: Researchers must interpret survey results carefully because cultural differences may influence how participants understand the questions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须谨慎解读调查结果，因为文化差异可能影响参与者对问题的理解。

col: interpret something as｜将某事理解为
tip: interpret可指口译；笔译通常用translate。

senses.en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something
to stop an activity or process for a time

ex.en: Please don't interrupt me while I explain the rules.
ex.zh: 我讲解规则时，请不要打断我。

ex.en: Frequent phone notifications can interrupt students' concentration and reduce the amount they learn during independent study.
ex.zh: 频繁的手机通知会打断学生的注意力，减少他们在自主学习中的收获。

col: interrupt the flow｜打断连贯过程
tip: interrupt指中途打断；disrupt侧重扰乱正常进程。

senses.en: to become involved in a situation to influence what happens
to interrupt a conversation with a comment
to happen between events, sometimes preventing a planned action

ex.en: The coach intervened before the argument became more heated.
ex.zh: 教练在争论进一步升级之前进行了调解。

ex.en: Governments may need to intervene when market competition fails to provide affordable essential services.
ex.zh: 当市场竞争无法提供价格可承受的基本服务时，政府可能需要干预。

col: intervene in a dispute｜介入纠纷
tip: 不及物动词：intervene in sth；不能直接接宾语。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to include something as a necessary part
to make someone take part in an activity

ex.en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
ex.zh: 我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。

ex.en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。

col: involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事
tip: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.

ex.en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。

ex.en: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
ex.zh: 用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。

col: a jet of water｜一股喷射的水流
tip: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.

ex.en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
ex.zh: 那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。

ex.en: A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众舆论的报道前，应仔细核实信息。

tip: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Give good reasons for an action, decision, or belief.

ex.en: I cannot justify buying another coat this winter.
ex.zh: 我找不到理由今年冬天再买一件外套。

ex.en: Governments must justify major infrastructure spending by demonstrating clear benefits for the wider community.
ex.zh: 政府必须通过展示对整个社区的明确益处，来证明重大基础设施支出的合理性。

col: justify a decision｜为决定提供理由
justify the cost｜证明费用合理
justify doing something｜证明做某事合理
tip: justify后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

senses.zh: a.哈萨克族的n.哈萨克族人

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a small attached piece giving information about something
to attach information to something for identification
to describe someone or something in a particular way

ex.en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
ex.zh: 洗新毛衣之前，先看看标签。

ex.en: Schools should avoid labelling children as failures, since this can damage their confidence and motivation.
ex.zh: 学校应避免给孩子贴上失败者的标签，因为这会损害他们的信心和学习动力。

col: label someone as｜将某人定性为
tip: 英式过去式labelled，美式常用labeled。

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
ex.zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

ex.en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
ex.zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

senses.en: the ability or activity of guiding people towards shared goals
the people who direct an organisation or country

ex.en: Her calm leadership helped our team finish the project.
ex.zh: 她沉着的领导帮助我们团队完成了项目。

ex.en: Effective leadership in schools can improve staff morale and create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 有效的学校领导可以提升教职工士气，并营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: under the leadership of｜在……的领导下
tip: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

senses.en: A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.

ex.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
ex.zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张介绍新图书馆的传单。

ex.en: Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.
ex.zh: 医疗中心可以发放宣传单，解释规律运动如何帮助预防几种常见疾病。

tip: leaflet通常是单页或折页；brochure通常为小册子。

senses.en: An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it.
To let liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack.
To reveal private information without permission.

ex.en: A leak under the sink soaked all our cleaning cloths.
ex.zh: 水槽下方的漏水把我们所有的清洁布都浸湿了。

ex.en: Water companies should repair leaks promptly to conserve resources and reduce unnecessary pressure on local supplies.
ex.zh: 供水公司应及时修复漏水处，以节约资源并减轻当地供水的不必要压力。

col: leak confidential information｜泄露机密信息
tip: leak 可作名词或动词，也可指秘密信息泄露。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.

ex.en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
ex.zh: 她把大部分闲暇时间都花在花园里。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了经济实惠的休闲空间，帮助城市居民放松并维持社交联系。

col: at your leisure｜在你方便时；从容地
tip: leisure通常不可数；leisure time指闲暇时间。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: According to the exact, ordinary meaning of the words.
Used to stress that something is actually true.

ex.en: He took my advice literally and bought a bigger plate.
ex.zh: 他按字面理解了我的建议，买了一个更大的盘子。

ex.en: Translating idioms literally can confuse language learners because their meanings often depend on cultural context.
ex.zh: 直译习语可能让语言学习者困惑，因为其含义往往取决于文化语境。

col: take something literally｜按字面理解某事
tip: 口语可用于夸张；正式写作宜保留字面或确实义。

senses.en: Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly.
Relating to the formal rules of correct reasoning.

ex.en: Taking the bus seemed logical because parking was expensive.
ex.zh: 停车费很贵，所以乘公交车似乎很合理。

ex.en: Students should learn to construct logical arguments rather than simply memorise facts for examinations.
ex.zh: 学生应该学习如何构建合乎逻辑的论证，而不是仅仅为考试背诵事实。

tip: logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。

senses.en: not firmly attached or held in place
not fitting closely around the body
not exact or strictly controlled

ex.en: One loose screw made the whole chair feel shaky.
ex.zh: 一颗松动的螺丝让整把椅子都摇晃起来。

ex.en: Loose regulations on industrial waste can allow harmful substances to enter rivers and damage local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对工业废物监管不严，可能导致有害物质进入河流，破坏当地生态系统。

tip: loose是形容词，尾音/s/；lose是动词，尾音/z/。

senses.en: Either of the two chest organs used for breathing.

ex.en: The doctor listened to my lungs through a stethoscope.
ex.zh: 医生用听诊器听了听我的肺部。

ex.en: Long periods of exposure to polluted air can damage the lungs and increase the risk of respiratory disease.
ex.zh: 长期接触受污染的空气可能损伤肺部，并增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

tip: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。

senses.en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions.
Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential.
Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.

ex.en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
ex.zh: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。

ex.en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
ex.zh: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。

col: afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Done by hand or operated by a person, not automatically.
Involving physical work rather than mainly mental work.
A book giving instructions for using or doing something.

ex.en: This manual coffee grinder takes some effort to turn.
ex.zh: 这个手动咖啡研磨器转起来有些费力。

ex.en: Although automation increases productivity, many industries still rely on manual labour for complex tasks.
ex.zh: 尽管自动化提高了生产率，许多行业仍依靠体力劳动来完成复杂任务。

tip: 作形容词指手动或体力的；作名词指手册。

senses.en: Extremely large, heavy, or solid.
Extremely great in amount, extent, or degree.

ex.en: A massive oak tree shades our entire garden.
ex.zh: 一棵巨大的橡树为我们整个花园遮阴。

ex.en: The transition to renewable energy requires massive investment in infrastructure and training for workers.
ex.zh: 向可再生能源转型需要在基础设施和工人培训方面投入大量资金。

tip: 既可形容体积巨大，也可形容投入或变化程度极大。

senses.en: Behaving sensibly and showing good judgment
Fully grown or developed
To become fully developed or more sensible

ex.en: Leila gave a mature response when her plans changed.
ex.zh: 计划改变时，莱拉作出了成熟理智的回应。

ex.en: Living independently can help young adults mature as they learn to manage money and resolve everyday problems.
ex.zh: 独立生活能帮助年轻人在学习理财和解决日常问题的过程中变得成熟。

col: a mature student｜成年后重返校园的学生
tip: 既可指身体发育成熟，也可指处事明智。

senses.zh: 机械修理工；汽车修理工
senses.en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.

ex.en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
ex.zh: 修理工发现我们的汽车底部有一处泄漏。

ex.en: As electric vehicles become more common, mechanics need additional training to maintain their complex systems safely.
ex.zh: 随着电动汽车日益普及，修理工需要接受额外培训，以安全地维护其复杂系统。

col: a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工
work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

senses.en: relating to machines or their moving parts
done without thought, interest, or feeling

ex.en: A mechanical fault stopped our car outside the village.
ex.zh: 一处机械故障让我们的车停在了村外。

ex.en: Regular inspections can identify mechanical problems before they cause serious disruptions to public transport services.
ex.zh: 定期检查可以在机械问题严重影响公共交通服务之前将其发现。

col: a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation
all members of a group, or the total member count

ex.en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
ex.zh: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。

ex.en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
ex.zh: 价格合理的会员费可以鼓励更多居民使用当地体育设施，改善健康状况。

col: renew your membership｜续办会员资格
tip: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

senses.en: only, and nothing more or more important

ex.en: I wasn't complaining; I was merely asking a question.
ex.zh: 我不是在抱怨，只是在问个问题。

ex.en: Building more roads merely shifts traffic problems elsewhere unless governments also invest in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非政府同时投资可靠的公共交通，否则修建更多道路只会把交通问题转移到别处。

col: merely a matter of｜仅仅是……的问题
tip: 语气比only正式；通常置于实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a person who carries a message to someone

ex.en: A messenger arrived with an envelope for the manager.
ex.zh: 一名送信人带着一封给经理的信到了。

ex.en: Before modern telecommunications, governments relied on messengers to carry important information between distant towns and military posts.
ex.zh: 在现代电信出现之前，政府依靠信使在相距遥远的城镇和军事哨所之间传递重要信息。

col: act as a messenger｜充当传话人
tip: message 是信息；messenger 是传递信息的人。

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre

ex.en: The shelf was just a millimetre too wide to fit.
ex.zh: 架子只宽了一毫米，却放不进去。

ex.en: Even a few millimetres of sea level rise can increase flood risks for vulnerable coastal communities over time.
ex.zh: 随着时间推移，即使海平面仅上升几毫米，也会增加脆弱沿海社区的洪灾风险。

tip: 缩写为mm；美式拼写为millimeter；一厘米等于十毫米。

senses.en: a natural substance found in rocks, soil, food, or water
relating to minerals found in the earth

ex.en: The museum displayed a mineral with bright purple crystals.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一块带有亮紫色晶体的矿物。

ex.en: Countries with abundant mineral resources need effective regulations to limit the environmental damage caused by mining.
ex.zh: 矿产资源丰富的国家需要有效的法规，以限制采矿造成的环境破坏。

tip: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。

senses.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

ex.en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚请尽量保持安静。

ex.en: A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善低薪服务业劳动者的生活水平。

col: keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度
tip: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

senses.en: Not very serious, important, or large.
A person younger than the legal age of adulthood.
Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.

ex.en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车只需要稍作修理。

ex.en: Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 日常出行习惯的小改变，累积起来可以减少人口密集城区的污染。

tip: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: tiny water drops in the air that reduce visibility
to become or make something covered with tiny water drops

ex.en: A thin mist floated above the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，湖面上飘着一层薄雾。

ex.en: Drivers should reduce their speed when mist limits visibility on rural roads during the early morning.
ex.zh: 清晨薄雾使乡村道路能见度降低时，驾驶员应减速行驶。

tip: mist通常比fog稀薄；玻璃起雾可说mist over。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.
A setting that controls how a device or system operates.

ex.en: I switched my phone to silent mode before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前，我把手机调成了静音模式。

ex.en: Cycling is an environmentally friendly mode of transport that can also improve public health in urban areas.
ex.zh: 骑行是一种环保的交通方式，也能改善城市居民的健康。

tip: 方式常用mode of；设备处于某模式用in ... mode。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: not boasting about your abilities or achievements
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: Despite winning the race, she remained modest about her success.
ex.zh: 尽管赢了比赛，她谈起自己的成功时仍很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。
教材补充词；首次出现于高二，来源：选择性必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.

ex.en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
ex.zh: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。

tip: 复数可写mosquitoes或mosquitos。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: the act or process of moving
a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting
to signal something using a movement of your hand or head

ex.en: The gentle motion of the boat made me sleepy.
ex.zh: 小船轻轻摇晃，让我昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: The council passed a motion to improve public transport and reduce traffic in residential areas.
ex.zh: 议会通过了一项动议，旨在改善公共交通并减少住宅区的车流。

tip: 动议可用pass或reject；in motion表示在运动中。

senses.en: to make someone eager to do something
to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起训练能激励我坚持锻炼。

ex.en: Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.
ex.zh: 教师可以把课堂内容与日常经历联系起来，激励学生探索难学的科目。

col: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事
tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

senses.en: Eager and willing to work towards a goal.
Driven by a particular reason or purpose.

ex.en: I feel more motivated after exercising in the morning.
ex.zh: 早晨运动之后，我感觉更有干劲。

ex.en: Students are more likely to remain motivated when teachers provide constructive feedback and achievable goals.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和可实现的目标时，学生更有可能保持学习动力。

col: motivated by profit｜受利润驱动的
tip: motivated to do表示有动力做；by引出动机。
